heading: Ways to work together.
intro: Four engagement formats. Pick the one that matches the shape of your problem — or tell me you need something custom.

items.title: Build engagement
items.description: End-to-end product, automation, or integration work shipped to production. Custom AI apps, internal tools, ERPs, CMSs — designed, engineered, and deployed under one roof. Priced per milestone after a scoped plan.

items.title: Prototype sprint
items.description: A short engagement to pressure-test an AI idea before you commit to a full build. You walk away with a working demo, an honest read on whether to keep going, and the architecture brief for what comes next.

items.title: Advisory retainer
items.description: GTM and RevOps work at a leadership cadence. ICP, pricing, sales process, pipeline, the playbook to run it. Standalone, or layered onto a build engagement when the strategy and the system need to ship together.

items.title: Audit & assessment
items.description: A focused review of one surface area — your AI roadmap, your ops stack, your GTM motion — with concrete recommendations and a build plan. Useful before committing to a larger engagement.

ctaText: Not sure which fits? Let's scope it together.
